turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure.

Present continuous: **am/is/are + -ing** (now).
Example: Two children are playing football.

Exercise: Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
